title: Shiha Distribution: Statistical Properties and Applications to Reliability Engineering and Environmental Data
summary: This paper introduces a new two-parameter distribution, referred to as the Shiha distribution, which provides a flexible model for skewed lifetime data with either heavy or light tails. The proposed distribution is applicable to various fields, including reliability engineering, environmental studies, and related areas. We derive its main statistical properties, including the moment generating function, moments, hazard rate function, quantile function, and entropy.
